Name: CP-MMAP Junimo Rug - Spawns Junimos and Firefly
Author: catissocute
Description:
[size=4][b]介绍：15款祝尼魔地毯，可以生成对应颜色的三只祝尼魔和萤火虫。[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB[/url]或者[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]获取。[/b]
[/size][b]

[/b][size=4][b]可选文件：（功能一致）
16x16的透明地毯，可以配合[url=https://github.com/Sparky56p/AnythingAnywhere/releases]anything anthere[/url] 的[i][u]家具可以重叠放置[/u][/i]功能使用 ❤
[/b][/size]
[size=6]-----------------------------------------------[/size][size=6]
[/size][b][size=4]使用教程：[/size][/b][size=4]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]需要前置CP和MMAP[/size]
[*][size=4]控制农夫经过地毯的【中间部分】，会生成祝尼魔和萤火虫[/size]
[*][size=4]如果想要修改生成的数量：打开content.json文件，下滑找到[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][size=4][b] ﻿例子：绿色祝尼魔地毯[/b][/size]
[size=3][b][i] ﻿"Value": "mushymato.MMAP_Critter Crab {{ModId}}/critters/Junimo-green 3 Firefly T 3 ", 
[/i][/b][/size]
[size=4]其中的数字【3】对应生成的数量，可以任意修改。不想要萤火虫，就把萤火虫对应的数字修改为0（不要直接删除代码，以防万一后面又想要了）[/size]
[b]--------------------------------------------------------------[/b]
[b][size=4]Tutorial:[/size][/b][size=4]
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=4]CP and MMAP are required[/size]
[*][size=4]Controlling the farmer passing through the middle part of the rug will spawn Junimo and Fireflies[/size]
[*][size=4]If you want to modify the number of builds, open the content.json file and scroll down to find :[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size] [size=4][b]﻿Example:Green Junimo rug[/b][/size]
[size=4][b][i]﻿"Value": "mushymato. MMAP_Critter Crab {{ModId}}/critters/Junimo-green 3 Firefly T 3 ",

[/i][/b][/size][size=4]﻿The number [3] corresponds to the generated quantity and can be modified at will. If you don't want fireflies, change the number corresponding to fireflies to 0 (don't delete the code directly, just in case you want it later)[/size]
